info.name: OBSOLETE Get the chart client configuration

items.docs:
Returns configuration data for the chart client.
                Including:
                Maximum/minimum amount of samples to request
                Request frequency
                Timeout values

info.name: OBSOLETE Get chart data for an instrument.

params.name: Count
params.description: Optional number of samples. Max. is 1200, default is 0.

params.name: Horizon
params.description:
The horizon to get samples from. Values are interpreted in minutes: 1, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60, 120,
                240, 360, 480, 1440, 10080, 43200.

params.name: Mode
params.description:
Defines how to get the data from the chart feed server. Following options are available: START,
                FROM, UPTO

params.name: Seq
params.description:
Optional sequence id that is repeated in the response to help clients correlate responses with
                requests. Must be an integer

params.name: Symbol
params.description: The symbol of the instrument to retreive data for. NB! Symbol is case sensitive.

params.name: Time
params.description:
Optional UTC time of the first/last sample. This depends on the MODE parameter. (MODE=FROM => time
                equals first sample, MODE=UPTO => time equals last sample).

params.name: Tz
params.description:
Optional time zone to get UTC-offsets for. Must be a zone name from the tz-database
                (http://www.iana.org/time-zones). Example: Australia/Hobart

params.name: Version
params.description: Optional protocol version. If not specified the default version 105 will be used.

items.docs: Responsible for getting chart data for an instrument from the back end domain.

params.name: ContextId
params.description: Unique streaming context ID part of the streaming session.

params.name: ReferenceId
params.description: The reference id that identifies the subscription (within a streaming session).

items.docs: Removes subscriptions for the given reference id on this resource, and frees resources on the server.

params.name: ContextId
params.description: Unique streaming context ID part of the streaming session.

params.name: Tag
params.description: Tag that subscriptions are marked with.

items.docs: Removes all subscriptions for the current session on this resource, and frees all resources on the server.

info.name: Create a subscription on chart data

items.docs:
Sets up a subscription and returns an initial snapshot of most recently completed samples specified by the parameters in the request.
            

            Subsequent samples are delivered over the streaming channel. Most often a single new sample or sample update is delivered at a time, 
            but when a sample closes, you will typcially get two samples: The now closed bar, and the bar just opening.
            


            Two events may require that a client application must close

info.name: Obsolete Create a subscription on chart data

items.docs:
Sets up a subscription and returns an initial snapshot of most recently completed samples specified by the parameters in the request.
            

            Subsequent samples are delivered over the streaming channel. Most often a single new sample or sample update is delivered at a time, 
            but when a sample closes, you will typcially get two samples: The now closed bar, and the bar just opening.
            


            Two events may require that a client application must close

params.name: Count
params.description: Specifies maximum number of samples to return. Maximum is 1200. If not specified a default of 1200 samples are returned.

params.name: FieldGroups
params.description: Use FieldGroups to add additional information to the samples like display/formatting details or information about the price source. If FieldGroups are not specified in the request then the response defaults to only hold the bare OHLC samples and nothing else.

params.name: Horizon
params.description: The time period that each sample covers. Values are interpreted in minutes: 1, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60, 120, 240, 360, 480, 1440, 10080, 43200.

params.name: Mode
params.description: If Time is supplied, mode specifies if the endpoint should returns samples "UpTo" (and including) or "From" (and including) the specified time.

params.name: Time
params.description: Specifies the time of a sample, which must either be the first (If Mode=="From") or the last (if Mode=="UpTo") in the returned data.

params.name: Uic
params.description: UIC (Universal Instrument Code) of the instrument.

items.docs: Returns timestamped OHLC samples for a single instrument identified by UIC and AssetType. The time period covered by the samples and interval size between them are controlled by the combination of parameters Horizon, Time, Mode and Count.
